on_before_settle.description: Before settling a payment to an unknown seller, call this free preflight. decision=block means abort the settle (fail-open on gate unavailability by default).
on_before_settle.params: seller_wallet (or resource_name), price_usdc, agent_intent, queried_pubkey (your consumer wallet for attribution)
on_before_settle.block_semantics: decision=block → hard stop (do not sign/send). decision=warn → proceed only up to readiness_card.recommended_cap_usdc (or agent policy default 0.25 USDC); do not treat warn as refuse on clean counterparties. decision=allow → proceed up to the free-tier ceiling in recommended_cap_usdc. can_spend is price-aware: true whenever the supplied price_usdc fits under the cap.
on_before_settle.reference: Drop-in client hook: pip install twzrd-mcp (or npx -y twzrd-mcp-server) — fail-open onBeforeSettle helper. Or call POST /v1/intel/preflight directly before you sign.
on_before_settle.current_status: Preflight is live and free. The settle-time gate is ON in prod: it runs on the paid market-intel routes (when ?merchant= or seller_wallet is supplied) and on /v1/intel/trust/{pubkey} for a distinct seller_wallet. Call the free card first, then hit a paid surface with the counterparty context to arm a settle-time gate evaluation.
